availabilityZones.description: Availability zone names used by created or BYO subnets.

cidrBlock.description: VPC CIDR block when the VPC is created by this stack.

egressPublicIps.description: Public addresses allocated to this deployment's NAT; empty when unknown.

eipAllocationId.description: Elastic IP allocation ID backing the NAT gateway.

internetGatewayId.description: Internet gateway ID when created by this stack.

isByoVpc.description: True when the VPC is owned outside this stack.

natGatewayId.description: NAT gateway ID when created by this stack.

oneOf.description: Dedicated sandbox networking to verify after setup; absent on older imports.

gatewayCidrs.description: Only destinations permitted by the connector security group.

gatewaySubnetIds.description: Dedicated NAT-routed subnets for the gateway's internal load balancer.

sandboxCidrs.description: Source ranges permitted on the gateway proxy port.

vpcCidrs.description: Every associated VPC IPv4 range, denied by the gateway.

workloadCidrs.description: Source ranges permitted on the gateway admin port.

securityGroupId.description: Security group ID for private workloads.

subnetsByFailureDomain.description: Exact subnet membership keyed by real availability zone.

additionalProperties.description: AWS subnets grouped by their real availability zone.

privateSubnetIds.description: Private subnet IDs in this availability zone.

publicSubnetIds.description: Public subnet IDs in this availability zone.

vpcId.description: VPC ID. Absent when default-VPC mode defers lookup to AWS at runtime.
